__baseline_prompt__.text: A surreal photographic scene of the person from the supplied portrait encountering a visibly impossible state. Use the supplied portrait as the face-and-hair appearance guide: retain the softly rounded face, dark brown eyes, short dark bob and fine wispy bangs. In a quiet alteration room, a white marble curtain hangs from a plain brass rod beside a tall window. The marble is solid mineral, with continuous gray veins, subtle crystalline sparkle and a chipped lower edge exposing its substantial stone thickness, yet its whole sheet yields into deep soft cloth folds. The person stands beside it, gently lifting one lower corner with the left hand; the thick stone edge curls around the fingers as effortlessly as a handkerchief. The left forearm, wrist, fingers and the lifted edge are visible together, and the free right hand rests loosely at the person's waist. Both feet rest on the wooden floor beneath a relaxed upright stance. A small wooden stool under the hanging sheet holds an untouched pair of dressmaker's shears: the alteration has paused at the discovery that stone can gather like fabric. The face is turned three quarters toward the lifted corner, lips slightly parted, with a quiet look of absorbed curiosity. A simple charcoal sleeveless knit top and high-waisted ivory trousers give the presence an understated softness. Frame from head to feet with ample room around the entire curtain, letting the face, hand contact, stone cross-section and broad folded surface share readable focus. Soft side daylight grazes the folds and lights the face, with gentle natural skin sheen and warm floor reflections. Restrained photographic color, credible small surface flaws, an inhabited stillness, and the sharply contradictory material relationship carry the image.
